definitions.cohort: Shared valid initial answer choices with at least two distinct legal options; eight choices in MA-RAG-int and 17 in MedLA.
definitions.accuracy: Final correct answers divided by all questions in the initial-disagreement cohort; missing final options count as incorrect.
definitions.gain_pp: Method accuracy minus reference accuracy, in percentage points.
definitions.correction: Reference incorrect and comparison method correct on the same question.
definitions.regression: Reference correct and comparison method incorrect on the same question.
definitions.correction_rate_percent: Corrections divided by reference errors in the same cohort, multiplied by 100.
definitions.uncertainty: 95% paired-question percentile bootstrap intervals, 20000 resamples, statistical seed 20261003; two-sided exact McNemar p-values for each comparison.
